Chapter 13: The Future of Storytelling—New Voices, New Shapes.
Have you noticed how, as our world changes, so do the stories we tell?
With every new technology, every emerging culture, and every fresh voice, the landscape of storytelling keeps shifting. But here’s something interesting—the core patterns, those seven basic plots, still give us a solid foundation. They’re like the building blocks, always ready for someone to create something new.
Picture a young creator, exploring virtual reality or designing their first interactive game. Sure, the tools are cutting-edge, but the heart of the story? It’s familiar. There’s still a hero facing monsters, a journey leading to growth, and the ever-present chance for transformation or rebirth. The details may change, but those age-old patterns? They adapt, not vanish.
What’s really exciting is how new voices are stepping in, shaking up the old rules. Stories that were once pushed aside—or never told at all—are finally getting their moment. Those basic plots are being stretched, reimagined, and made richer by fresh perspectives. The result? A tapestry of stories that’s more colorful, more complex, and more alive than ever before.
The future of storytelling is wide open. We’ll always lean on those seven core plots to help us make sense of the world, but the ways we use them? Nobody can really predict that.
The real challenge is staying open—to new stories, new voices, and new ways of seeing things.
And here’s something most people overlook: we all have incredible power as storytellers. Every conversation, every memory, every dream is a chance to shape a narrative. The seven basic plots? They’re just a starting point—not a limit.
So, if you’re ready to imagine something new, the future is yours to create.
